main_text.p: רָחַץ Ch. Fidit, Confidit vel Confisus est, Fiduciam habuit, Speravit. Ithpeh אִתְרְחַץ Idem. Aphel אַרְחִץ Fidere, Confidere fecit.
רְחִצָנָא & רוּחְצָנָא Ch. Fiducia, confidentia, spes, securitas. Cum præfixa præposit. לְרוּחְצָן Confidenter, Secure.

רָחַק Ch. Procul, longè, longinquum, remotum esse, abesse, existere vel distare, longè abscedere, discedere, recedere: Item activè Rejicere, 1.Sam. 16.1. quod rectius legeretur רְחַקְתָּיו ex Pahel, Ithpah, אִתְרְחַק vel אִתְרְחַק ex Ithpeh. Idem: Item, Abominandum, abominabile esse vel fieri. Syr. ܪܚܩ Procul discede ab eis, 1.ad Timot.6.3. Aphel אַרְחִיק Ch. & Syr. Abscedere, Recedere facere, amovere, removere, submovere: Rejicere, respuere, reprobare, spernere, aspernari, fastidire, abominari, detestari. Pahel רַחֵק Idem. Syr. ܐܪܚܩ Rejecit eum, ad Rom.11.1.
רְחִיק רָחִיק Ch. & Syr. Longinquus, longinquum, remotus: Longè, procul. Plur. רְחִיקִין. Fœmin. רְחִיקָא Longinqua, remota. Plur. רְחִיקָן.
ܪܚܝܩܘ Syr. Longinquū, lōginquitas: ܒܪܚܝܩ De longinquo, Longè, procul: ܒܪܚܝܩ In longinquum, longè.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldaic and Syriac script is transcribed as far as legible; vowel points and some Syriac forms are approximate and marked as doubtful where the scan is unclear. The final Hebrew word at the lower right is set apart and reads as printed.
